item.description: Elevate TV is a Kenyan based television based in Nairobi Kenya. We broadcasts in locally produced and imported content in English and Kiswahili languages. item.title: Exciting News, Life Church International, South Africa Launched | Elevate TV
item.description: Today, 23rd July 2023 we Launched Life Church International, Durban South Africa . We are expecting the church to take off in evangelizing, Discipling, equipping and commissioning the saints to their ministerial functions.

item.title: Happy New Year 2024: The Year of The Open Door! | Elevate TV
item.description: As we usher in the new year, a prophetic declaration resonates within our hearts and echoes from the leadership of Apostle David Juma and Pastor Asunta Juma: 2024 is the "Year of The Open Door." This divine theme draws inspiration from the scriptures, specifically 1 Corinthians 16:9: "For a wide door for effective work has opened to me, and there are many adversaries."

item.title: Elevate TV App: Now Available on Huawei App Gallery & Play Store
item.description: Elevate TV's empowering content is now at your fingertips! Download our app from the Huawei App Gallery or Play Store to access inspirational programming anytime, anywhere. Join us on our mission to uplift and empower families worldwide.

item.title: 🔴Standing Strong Ministers Conference Postponed to 1st-4th October 2024
item.description: Shalom and choice greetings in the Name of Our Lord Jesus Christ. We regret to inform you that owing to the ongoing protests and riots (which have manifested in the destruction of both private and public infrastructure) the Conference has been postponed.

item.title: Vote for Elevate TV as Christian TV Station of the Year 2024 | Elevate TV
item.description: Now, we need your support to bring this award home! It’s time for you to cast your vote and help us secure this win. Your vote will help us continue to inspire, uplift, and spread the message of faith and hope through Elevate TV.

item.title: Elevate TV Triumphs as Christian TV Station of the Year 2024! 🎉 | Elevate TV
item.description: We are overwhelmed with joy and gratitude to announce that Elevate TV has officially been crowned Christian TV Station of the Year 2024 at the prestigious Tukuza Awards, held on 8th December 2024 at the iconic KICC Nairobi!
